2609.31763.title: SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support
2609.31763.paper_summary: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.
2609.31763.paper_summary_zh: 長期背景的臨床 AI 系統可能會在先前的入院紀錄超出主動推理背景時，錯過相關的病歷。在重症監護病房的監測中，即使早期生命徵象的變化類似於先前的惡化模式，也可能顯得不具特異性。SMARtCARE 通過四個狀態的臨床決策支持架構來解決這一問題：穩定、元認知、輔助和受管制（撤銷）。SMARtCARE 並不是自動檢索先前的紀錄，而是使用患者先前軌跡的有損六通道指紋。當當前的變化與該指紋匹配且上下文中缺少先前紀錄時，系統會為臨床醫生的審查提出元認知升級；完整的檢索僅在輔助狀態下通過臨床醫生的行動來實現。設計了一個患者身份保護機制，以確保在數據加載、記錄和審計層中的正確歸屬。評估結合了一個合成的蒙地卡羅研究，該研究驗證了狀態轉換邏輯和估計器的穩定性，而非臨床表現，並在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 臨床數據庫演示上進行了真實數據運行。在 MIMIC-III 中，在 14 名兩次入院的患者中識別出一個先前模式的重現；在 MIMIC-IV 中，該管道在 9 名兩次入院的患者中未產生任何指紋匹配，這顯示了固定典範模式庫的一個關鍵限制。在這兩次運行中，所有記錄的決策都能完全追溯並正確歸屬。這些結果支持 SMARtCARE 作為一個可追溯的、注重隱私的機制，用於揭示中等背景風險；它們並不是臨床有效性的聲明。
